Learning review 1: after investigating retry storms, the team concluded that bounded retries with a persisted backoff decision prevent duplicate side effects. This learning applies to the NorthStar delivery portfolio and should shape future runbooks and reviews.

Learning review 2: after investigating unowned alerts, the team concluded that every operational alert needs one named escalation owner before release. This learning applies to the NorthStar delivery portfolio and should shape future runbooks and reviews.

Learning review 3: after investigating prompt exports, the team concluded that redaction must run before any prompt payload leaves the application boundary. This learning applies to the NorthStar delivery portfolio and should shape future runbooks and reviews.

Learning review 4: after investigating stale embeddings, the team concluded that vector refresh must follow the durable-note update rather than precede it. This learning applies to the NorthStar delivery portfolio and should shape future runbooks and reviews.

Learning review 5: after investigating silent data fixes, the team concluded that each correction needs a reversible runbook and an independently checked count. This learning applies to the NorthStar delivery portfolio and should shape future runbooks and reviews.

Learning review 6: after investigating ambiguous status reports, the team concluded that a status update must distinguish confirmed facts from a tentative forecast. This learning applies to the NorthStar delivery portfolio and should shape future runbooks and reviews.

Learning review 7: after investigating retrieval noise, the team concluded that context budgets should favor direct evidence over loosely related keyword matches. This learning applies to the NorthStar delivery portfolio and should shape future runbooks and reviews.

Learning review 8: after investigating handoff gaps, the team concluded that a decision record needs an explicit owner and due date before it can be closed. This learning applies to the NorthStar delivery portfolio and should shape future runbooks and reviews.

Learning review 9: after investigating schema drift, the team concluded that contract checks must run before asynchronous workers process a new payload shape. This learning applies to the NorthStar delivery portfolio and should shape future runbooks and reviews.

Learning review 10: after investigating incident summaries, the team concluded that a post-incident note should separate cause, impact, mitigation, and follow-up. This learning applies to the NorthStar delivery portfolio and should shape future runbooks and reviews.
